full_judgment: Md. Ruhul Amin J.:- This appeal, by leave, is by the defendant No.1 against the judgment of the High Court Division dated February 1, 1999 in Civil Revision No.1182 of 1997 making the Rule absolute upon reversing the judgment and decree dated October 7, 1996 of the Court of Subordinate Judge (now Joint District Judge) Faridpur, in Title Appeal No.24 of 1995 affirming those of dated February 18, 1995 of the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Faridpur passed in Title Suit No.84 of 1993 dismissing the same. The suit was filed seeking declaration that the Memo. No.13/Sa dated 11.7.1993 issued by the defendant No.1 (herein appellant) is illegal, nul and void, in operative, without jurisdiction and not binding upon the plaintiff.
